receipts.reliability_k: SPEC §4, policy ratio (owner 2026-10-10: Sonnet 5.5 near 0.9 with 13 failed guarantee rows is not discriminating): each of the 18 groups (a tier other than E) multiplies the score by 1 - K x the shortfall of its worst eligible row, so a group whose worst row fails completely by 0.90; the 2026-10-10 pilots' stored rows recompose (per group) to Sol hardened 0.9793 -> 0.8248, Sonnet hardened 0.9628 -> 0.7450, Sol lean 0.9618 -> 0.6990, Haiku 0.3378 -> 0.0998; the six hardened reference verdicts keep reliability 1
receipts.reliability_floor: SPEC §4, policy ratio: the groups together never take the score below a quarter of what the tests earned; reached only when 14 or more of the 18 groups fail completely (0.90^13 = 0.254, 0.90^14 = 0.229) — no kept verdict reaches it (Haiku 0.2954 with 14 groups, several partly)
